Pandava.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy

Pandava.fact: They heard from a group of travelling sages about a contest (svayamvara) being held in the Kingdom of Panchala that offered Draupadi's hand in marriage to the winner. Pandava.fact: Krishna was then told that war was going to be held and Arjuna and Duryodhana had come to him seeking his military help. To this Krishna replied that he had seen Arjuna first and so he would give him priority, and asked what he needed.
